text:
Version 5.0 is the biggest update we have shipped in years. We focused on speed, cleaner internals and a lighter long-term maintenance burden.

**Node 16 support removed**
Node 16 is past end-of-life, so it is no longer supported. Version 5.0 needs Node 18 or later. Dropping it lets us use modern runtime features and cut out old compatibility code.

**A new, faster router**
The routing engine was rebuilt from scratch and runs 2.3x faster than the old one in our benchmarks. Apps with large or deeply nested route trees should see the biggest gains in startup time and per-request overhead. The way you define routes stays familiar.

**Breaking changes**
This release has 7 breaking changes. Most of them affect router configuration, middleware signatures and a few deprecated APIs that have now been removed. The migration guide lists every change, with before-and-after examples.

**Automated migration**
To make upgrading easier, we provide a codemod that handles most of the changes for you:

```
npx framework-codemod v5
```

Run it, check the diff, then test your app. Upgrade today and tell us what you think on GitHub.
